title: [JL Lifestyle]  KTX BUSAN STATION  #ktxbusanstation #triptobusan #traintobusan
description:
KTX Busan Station is a  train station in Busan, South Korea. It is located in Jungang-daero, Choryang 3(sam)-dong, Dong-gu, Busan. It takes less than 3 hours from Seoul Station to KTX Busan Station by KTX train. KTX is a high-speed trains that connect Seoul to Busan. It is one of the most famous routes in South Korea. So, If you plan to visit Busan I highly recommend KTX for it is very comfortable and convenient.
